sources.fact: Authoritative LBBD34 Brownfield record identifies Vicarage Fields, Ripple Road.
The Brownfield-land record ended on 20 February 2025 and is not treated as a current open register entry.
The ended record gives a maximum of 850 net dwellings and permissioned status.
The ended record says owned-by-a-public-authority; this category is not a current proprietor/title readback.
The Brownfield-land record supplies a point and blank geometry.
Planning Data retains a historical LBBD34 multipolygon for Vicarage Fields; it is register geometry, not an HMLR title polygon.
The March 2023 Committee record identifies outline permission 16/01325/OUT dated 19 April 2017.
23/00182/NONMAT sought to extend timescales for submission of remaining reserved matters, except the primary school site.
Committee agreed reasons for approval and delegated authority to approve the non-material amendment subject to conditions.
The 2023 minutes record concerns about CPO inquiry outcome, viability, lack of progress and the need for a new phasing plan; this is delivery context, not cancellation or completion proof.
March 2018 Cabinet agreed in principle to use CPO powers and land referencing to facilitate regeneration; CPO governance is not current HMLR title verification.
No exact current replacement Brownfield record, complete reserved-matters set or current HMLR parcel relation was verified this wave.

examples.result: LBBD34 is treated as an ended Brownfield-land record after 20 February 2025.
Historic 850 capacity is not automatically carried into a new current register candidate.
Permissioned status is retained as historical record status, not current 2026 finality.
23/00182/NONMAT extends reserved-matters timing and does not create another 850 dwellings.
Outline, non-material amendment and CPO decisions are not additive housing schemes.
Historic multipolygon is not converted into an HMLR title polygon.
Public-authority ownership category and CPO powers are not current proprietor proof.
Promotion remains zero until a current replacement record/case, title relation and overlays are verified.
